label: Direct existential support versus a mediate thinking ground-ancestor
term: source of a thinker's existence under the selected dependence relation
resolution: PresentEsseSupport m supportsEsse w c x is an existing source c with a direct edge of the relation supportsEsse, which is a parameter of the definition (not one fixed primitive); it does not itself impose distinctness or thinkerhood. Instantiated with the same m.grounds, a distinct direct thinking supporter yields P(x) only through the ordinary Lean helper directThinkingSupportImpliesP (under the Cogito concreteness bridge EveryBearerIsConcrete); that helper is not a registered result, and the converse (mediate G+ thinker ancestry implies a direct thinking supporter) is not proved. ThinkerPredecessor in the #1791 selected reading is a distinct bearer of an occurring thought at the start of a nonempty finite path through ActualConcreteGround. This latter G+ ancestry relation is neither by definition nor by theorem a direct support relation; the P/¬P coverage statement is valid at a fixed selected reading only. The original idealist sustaining interpretation requires a separate semantic translation if it uses another direct or non-grounding relation. Neither silence about a support edge nor omission of an independence premise proves the negative horn.
